crm_notes:
Lead: Maj Gen (ret.) Thomas Ellery (CTO-equivalent) - strong preference for strictly air-gapped solution; cannot allow outbound telemetry.
Priority: replace aging document search and manual SOP drafting with inference-assisted workflows for classification, redaction, and after-action summaries.
Key quotes: "No cloud egress under any circumstance; we need attestable chain-of-custody for models and weights."
Technical constraints: legacy PKI, FIPS 140-2 HSMs on-site, no external package pulls except signed vendor image, SELinux hardened, STIG baseline.
Procurement note: will move to formal RFP if POC meets security gate 1 (attestation + offline deploy).
POC goals (short): 1) Demonstrate private deployment air-gapped with model artifact signing; 2) show end-to-end latency for query-heavy classified-doc search (target p99 < 250ms for 512-token queries internally); 3) validate KV/prefix cache persistence across reboots for mission continuity.
AE notes: pricing ask for 3-year reserved commit for Dedicated vs one-time Private license — ops prefer Private if attestation scope is satisfied.
Action items captured: see linked drive docs; SE to validate HSM integration checklist; security to draft vendor attestation template.
Stated blockers: hardware lead time, procurement CISO approval timeline, integration of legacy identity provider.
Tone: pragmatic — wants detailed prescriptive controls, not marketing.
use_case_summary: Primary: classified document search and incident analysis in air-gapped environments. Secondary: automated SOP and after-action summary generation to compress analyst turnaround. High throughput of short queries and frequent small-context retrieval; strong emphasis on deterministic output, audit trails, and model provenance. Needs ability to pin model hashes and run quantized variants on approved hardware.
notes_short: Air-gapped Private + attestation required. POC planned. Procurement lead engaged. SE working on HSM/KMS mapping.
